required_permissions: Read/search, selected-index and field discovery, and PIT create/delete on the approved source namespace; no document writes or index administration
Optional cluster/node/index statistics require separately approved monitor privileges; Kibana and Logstash have independent destinations and identities

capabilities.name: metrics
capabilities.summary: Mapped DSL/ES|QL metrics, units, weighted statistics and terminal windows in the expanded elastic pack
capabilities.remaining: Provider-only TLS trials cover Elasticsearch 8.14.3 and 9.1.0; qualify the complete controller/collector-to-archive workflow and hosted/serverless deployment modes separately

capabilities.name: diagnostics
capabilities.summary: Scrubbed projected logs, errors, transactions and spans with concrete-index document identity
capabilities.remaining: Qualify deployed application/APM mappings and the complete retained-evidence workflow; provider document pagination alone does not qualify durable retention

capabilities.name: trace_lookup
capabilities.summary: Observed trace IDs narrow approved queries and preserve correlation classification
capabilities.remaining: Qualify a live instrumented SUT, upstream sampling and missing ancestors across retained trace views

capabilities.name: run_header
capabilities.summary: Opt-in managed run-header propagation with authored-header conflict checks and frozen run scope
capabilities.remaining: Qualify deployed application ingestion of X-Apex-Test-Run and approved-origin redirect behavior with real indexed data

capabilities.name: esql
capabilities.summary: Constrained synchronous and capability-probed asynchronous ES|QL with mapped output and owned cleanup
capabilities.remaining: Provider-only synchronous/async trials passed on 8.14.3 and 9.1.0; qualify deployed permissions, serverless capabilities and durable controller/collector cleanup

capabilities.name: pagination
capabilities.summary: Bounded PIT/search-after reads preserve equal timestamps, index-scoped identity and immutable query windows
capabilities.remaining: Provider-only 10,005-record TLS trials passed; qualify multi-node outage, data-stream rollover and default durable retention quotas in a deployed run

capabilities.name: private_collector
capabilities.summary: Locally approved destinations and indices, sealed signed work, bounded spool replay and cleanup ownership
capabilities.remaining: Qualify an actual remote collector-to-vendor deployment, private DNS/TLS trust, restarts and controller failover

capabilities.name: component_health
capabilities.summary: Independently authorized cluster/index, Kibana and Logstash health with instantaneous measurement semantics
capabilities.remaining: Qualify deployed cluster-monitor roles and actual Kibana/Logstash APIs; local vendor trials covered search while cluster health was forbidden
